findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

The soap dispenser for the hand sink in the central isle by the manager’s office would not dispense soap at the beginning of the inspection. The PIC was shown and replaced the batteries in the dispenser. Soap then supplied when used. Ensure that all hand sinks are supplied/dispensing soap at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The tracks of the sliding lid and the inner roof on the left side of the ice machine were observed with slime growth. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean at all times. The location was cleaned to correct. Ensure that all food contact surface are maintained clean to sight and touch at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

Milk in the back reach in cooler were observed with internal temperature of 45F-47F. The milk was discarded to correct the immediate violation. It was believed that the cooler door was being wedged open by items inside and that re-arranging the items would help. The cooler was checked approximately 30 minutes later and was registering within acceptable limits at that time. Ensure that all cold holding is maintained at effective levels at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

Raw eggs are observed over open packages of cooked eggs and containers of milk in the walk in cooler. The PIC was shown and moved the eggs back into their box on the bottom shelf to correct. Ensure that all foods in coolers are stored according to their cooking order at all times to prevent possible cross contamination concern.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple pans that have been cleaned are observed with sticker remainders and residual. One pan was observed still oily and soiled as well. The PIC was shown and moved all of the observed items back to dish for recleaning. Ensure that all dishes are completely cleaned prior to storage and use.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

Milk in the central front reach in cooler was observed with internal temperature of 50F-52F. The milk was discarded to correct the immediate violation. The cooler was replaced during this inspection with a spare to allow for effective cold holding in this area.

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.19(C)(5) Time as a Public Health Control. (C) If time without temperature control is used as the public health control up to a maximum of 6 hours: (5) The food in unmarked containers or packages, or marked with a time that exceeds the 6-hour limit shall be discarded.

A tray of sliced tomatoes on temperature control were observed without time labels. The PIC was shown and discarded the pan to correct. Ensure that all time control procedures are maintained at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

1) Personal drinks are observed above the cake preparation stations. 2) A lunchable is observed on a shelf in the walk in cooler next to and above foods intended for consumers. 3) Personnel sweatshirts and backpacks are observed on top of cases of soda syrup. All items were shown to the PIC and discussed. The items were removed to correct. Ensure that all employee items are stored seperately from consumer items to prevent possible contamination concerns.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The dish machine at the northern end of the prep line registered low on inspector test strips during this inspection. Investigation showed that the jug was effectively out of concentrate. A new jug was attached and the concentration returned to effective levels. Violation corrected. Ensure that all sanitizers are at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The inside of the ice machine is observed with black spots around the inner wall of the ice container. A small amount of pink slime is observed on the deflector shield for this ice machine as well. The PIC was shown and had the equipment cleaned during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean and sanitized at all times.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Several ants are observed on the wall, windowsill and counters along the drive thru wall. The PIC was shown and instructed to contact their pest control agency for remediation. Cleaning and sealing wall junctions was discussed. Ensure that all pests are removed from the facility prior to the follow up. The follow up is being set for one month to allow pest control time to manage the situation.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

1) A Starbucks drink is observed in the walk in freezer next to foods intended for consumers. 2) A personal drink is observed on a shelf next to and over clean dishes in the back area. Both items were shown to the PIC and the items discarded to correct. Ensure that personal foods are stored separately from foods and food contact items intended for consumer foods.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

1) The scoop used for ice at the drink station is observed with the handle in contact with the ice during this inspection. 2) An employee was observed to use a cup to scoop out ice from the bin at the drink station. Education was conducted with the PIC and the scoop moved. Ensure that employees are storing and using the supplied equipment correctly at all times

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple pans and utensils are observed stored after cleaning, that have not been completely cleaned prior to storage. Items had observable food debris and sticker remains on them. The PIC was shown and the items moved back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all food and non-food contact items are completely cleaned prior to storage and use. Education and training with the dish washers is highly suggested.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

A box in the walk in cooler is observed with moisture and mold on the bottom. This has reached to the shelf it is stored on as well. All packaging is observed sealed still and the concern of food contamination is minimal at this time. The box was discarded and the shelf cleaned during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that the non-food contact surfaces are maintained free of soilage at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Numerous locations throughout the facility are observed with the single service/to-go containers stored with the food contact surfaces facing up/exposed. The locations were shown to the PIC during this inspection and the items flipped over to correct. This same issue was noted at several location on the previous routine inspection. Ensure that staff is educated and the single service items are stored so that the food contact surfaces are protected from possible contamination.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Multiple utensils in storage are observed with contaminants still present. Items include a metal lid, a grater and a strainer. The items were moved to cleaning again to correct the immediate violation. The PIC is instructed to review with the dish washers and ensure that dishes are fully cleaned prior to storage.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

1) A stack of burger containers is stored on the prep line with the food contact surfaces facing up; 2) to-go sauce containers are stores on the prep line with the food contact surfaces facing up; 3) salad container lids are stored above the salad prep cooler with the food contact surfaces facing up. The PIC was shown these items and instructed to store them so that the food contact surfaces are down and protected from contamination. The items were moved during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple location on the metal deflectors inside of the ice machine are observed with bacterial slime developing. PIC was consulted and stated that a company is normally contracted for cleaning and maintenance of this equipment. A ticket appears to have been submitted, but has not been fulfilled yet. PIC had the item cleaned/ sanitized during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

Two mops are observed stored with pooled heads in the empty mop bucket and ringer. PIC was consulted. There are multiple spots intended for storing wet mops over the mop sink and these should be used. The mops were moved to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: Dish machine near the catering area observed without measurable chlorine sanitizer. In the meantime and dishes will be washed, rinsed, and sanitized in the main dish area. CORRECTED— PIC was able to get dish machine to dispense properly. Observed at 100ppm Cl.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum concentration of 50-200 ppm. [P]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Foods observed out of temperature in the sandwich prep cooler (spicy sauce at 51F and mayo at 45F, probed) and on the hot dog/brat prep counters (shredded cheese at 51F and sliced cheese at 56F, probed). CORRECTED— Discussed alternative options (ice beneath pans, smaller portions, time as a control). PIC assured inspector that foods will be moved through quickly and that they likely aren’t on the line for longer than 2 hours. Inspector provided a Time as a Control policy sheet for PIC to consider. Inspector will follow up next week regarding a Time as a Control policy.
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Ice accumulation observed in both the front and back walk-in freezers. Remove ice and maintain free of accumulation so that freezers are smooth and easily cleanable.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Dish machine near the catering area observed without measurable chlorine sanitizer. PIC put a work order in and expects maintenance within the next couple days. Posted “NOT WORKING” in the meantime and dishes will be washed, rinsed, and sanitized in the main dish area.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum concentration of 50-200 ppm. [P]

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Sandwich knife observed stored in the ice bath used to cool shredded cheeses at that station. CORRECTED— Knife removed and will be sanitized before use. Store in-use utensils on a clean portion of the countertop.
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned. [C]
